pull_request.title: Software: Relax display validation and add module-only viewing
pull_request.head: software/independent-display-colours
pull_request.body:
This PR implements the requested independent display settings and single-module project. `root_color` may differ from config `rgb`, and effective ROOT transparency need not match config `alpha`. Actual stored ROOT attributes must still survive export/import. Undefined/wrong ROOT indices remain rejected; nodehammer applies its own configured RGB/alpha and checks the GLB output against those styles.

The repeatable preparation workflow writes `module.nhproj` and `module.glb`, selecting the first source module by `(system, layer, stave, module)` identifiers and its descendants: substrate, active sensor, ASIC, flex/glue and graphite contact shim. The current barrel selects `m23142`, with eight physical components and no stave, mounting or external service meshes. The report records the selected source module. Each archive embeds the semantic input and the corresponding selection.

After preparing the projects as described in `tools/nodehammer/README.md`, open the module view with:

```sh
build/nodehammer/native/nodehammer viewer open build/nodehammer/pixel/module.nhproj
```

Validation on the current main barrel baseline (2026-10-05):

- 16 pixel-export/display tests, 9 nodehammer safeguards and all 3 native CTests pass with DD4hep 1.38 / ROOT 6.40.04.
- All four nodehammer views pass entity, mesh-set, metre-unit and GLB RGBA checks: full 40114, sensitive 6794, stave 434 and module 8 physical mesh placements. Module audit checks 8 box dimensions and 10 transforms.
- 6794 sensitive elements match, 33970 pixel-cell checks pass, and no geometry overlaps are found at 0.00001 mm tolerance. ROOT display attributes survive a fresh-process round trip for 40114 physical volumes.
- 27 dashboard tests, dashboard validation/build and 94 session records pass. Hosted checks are reported separately below by GitHub.

Current source/runtime/config hashes and results are in `docs/validation/nodehammer/pr33-rebase.json`. Earlier `independent-colours.json` and `module-view.json` remain historical evidence from the original baseline and local palette. The current validation uses the committed palette; the user's uncommitted edits remain untouched.

Rebased onto main `279222749ceb53f58bf50de694d4763d435dddf1`. Documentation/tracking conflicts preserve both contributions. Regeneration exposed the original hardcoded `m1` selection; the identifier-based selection and regression tests restore compatibility with the current barrel.

Updated DES-012 display policy and software tracking. Native nodehammer blending remains an upstream limitation. No detector geometry, physical material, segmentation or design-approval changes.

where geoDisplay works, including sensitive/stave alternatives and the native

The explicit rebase request authorizes rewriting this PR's commits despite the
repository's ordinary-merge default. The update is restricted to the PR branch,
with an explicit force-with-lease against the original remote head. Main is not
rewritten. The existing local source branch and stale nodehammer worktree are
preserved rather than cleaned up during this task.

Conflicts in DES-012 and project tracking preserve the independent display policy,
newer PR34/35 barrel documentation, all main task/PR records, their dates and
approval boundaries, and the PR33 record. No session pairs were discarded.
`git range-diff` confirmed that the four-commit replay changed only conflict
context/metadata; source code was initially identical to the old PR.

The current barrel does not contain module `m1`. Module-only display selection
now derives the first source module by `(system, layer, stave, module)` IDs from
`expected.json`. Selection and mesh auditing use the same name; the report records
it. Synthetic regression fixtures check reordered inventories, hierarchical IDs
and absence of modules. The current selected module is `m23142`, with eight
physical component placements. No detector dimensions, physical materials,
segmentation or design approval were changed.
